answer: Re-attestations are stored in wharf and sable lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the terrace graph. Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 16 epochs, so holding a position calls for ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1555 impostors cost 969 times the honest price and take 17 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
